author: ClubberNugget
body:
Hello we are Redemption.  We are a newly founded team who are ready to build up and become a high level team on Avicus.

We believe communication and strategy can defeat pure skill, so we are looking for learners, strategists and friends to join our team.

We will accept players in a different fashion, how do you apply? Follow these instructions:

Enter your IGN:

Your Skype:

Your preferred position:

And answer this question, Coke or Pepsi?:

We do not judge by K/D but we may check your infractions because we want a positive environment in the team.

Once you are given the Tryouts tag, you will be invited to the team, but you are not a member yet.

We will then hold a tryout session with a batch of applicants, testing teamwork, ingenuity and pvp skills.

After that, at least one leader will interview you on Teamspeak or skype.

After that, you will either be kicked from the team or will be accepted as an official member.  If you make it to the tryouts and fail, you will be able to apply again.  We are making this a large process because a growing team needs devotion and persistence, we do not want fair-weather team members.

Every applicant will go through this process, no exceptions.

Although this all sounds rigorous and tough, maybe we seem like a harsh team, but once you make it in, you are a part of the family, and we will work together as a team to rise to the top.

What do you need to join?:

Teamspeak, Skype, Spirit, willingness to learn and to help out, a working or soon to be working mic and dank memes (⊙.⊙(◉̃_᷅◉)⊙.⊙)

Best of luck to all who apply

 

“Challenge Acceqted” – Acceqted2k15
